title: Contact Us
slide_intent: Give readers a clear route for questions the guide cannot settle. A visible contact can help a group resolve a new identity decision consistently.
strategic_value: CSAIL can direct requests for help with group or department identities to its Logo Committee.
demonstration: A short invitation and the committee email occupy the upper-left area of an otherwise open page. A turquoise geometric tab labels the section at right.
practical_value: Use the named committee as the guide’s point of contact when an application calls for further direction.

content_islands.name: Contact block
content_islands.spec: Place the heading, invitation and committee address together near the upper left.

content_islands.name: Section marker
content_islands.spec: Set a rotated Contact Us label inside a turquoise shape entering from the right edge. Leave the central field open.
